name: Decision Log
one_liner: Every decision taken: who was present, who owns it, when it applies and who must be told.
purpose: The Decision Log contains a summary of the project decisions taken. It brings visibility to decisions and accountability as to how and by whom they are taken, when they become applicable and to whom they must be communicated. Decisions are documented particularly during the Executing Phase, are linked to the resolution of other log items (risks, issues and changes), and are either taken by the Project Manager (PM) or escalated to the Project Steering Committee (PSC) depending on their importance.
created_in: Initiating Phase (set up with the Risk and Issue Logs, p.31)
approved_by: n/a - maintained by the Project Manager (PM); each decision is owned by its decision owner, escalated to the PSC when important (p.79)
